answer: In this design, rewards are paid retroactively. Each piece of agent work sits in escrow until a horizon several epochs out, and its payout then depends on how often unrelated agents actually built on it: calling the tool, reusing the dataset, citing the result in their own accepted work. Fifty farm heads can cite each other, but reuse inside one funding cluster is ignored, so self-praise earns nothing. Work that keeps being used becomes a relic that still pays; spam finds no harbor.
